$Comment: The skeleton every contract on Old Jack's board inherits through Parent. It is Abstract, so it
Listing files each child with the board's contracts. Boards posts a child in the board's night
slots; a contract for the daylight slots, or one drawn more often, writes its own Boards, which
replaces this list whole. Rewards is what every contract on the board pays, through Rewards.Auto
because the board goes away with the event and a Claim would wait a year for it: the board's pay
table, and favor with Old Jack and the Hallowed (the Reputation rewards; Amount is how much). A
child that writes its own Rewards.Auto replaces that list whole. Every shipped contract does, to
add MMO Skill Tree's Mmo_Xp row for the skill its work trains, so retuning this list means
It carries no Requires and no Objectives: each contract writes its own Requires, with the
Hallows_Eve_Live condition at the top that keeps it out of every draw while the event is off,
